3. We need to create an equation that equals 14.

- (3 + 7) + 22 - 2 = 10 + 22 - 2 = 30 (not 14)
- 3 + 7 + 22 - 2 = 32 (not 14)
- 3 + 7 - 22 + 2 = 0 (not 14)
- 3 + 22 - 7 + 2 = 20 (not 14)
